```{r include=FALSE}
require(tidyverse)
require(tigerstats)
davisdata <- read.csv(file="UCDavis.csv")
```

# introduction 
Our Goal is to find out if there is a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row you choose to sit in. $H_0$ would show us there is no relation between where the student sits and the consumption of their alcohol. The $H_A$ would mean that there is a relation between where the student sits and their consumption of alcohol. 

## Now with ggplot - first select the basic data

```{r}
basicCN <- ggplot(davisdata,aes(y=alcohol,x=Seat))
```
## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
basicCN + geom_boxplot()
```
  
  
### get fancy  

```{r}
basicCN + geom_boxplot(notch=TRUE,outlier.color = "red") + stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar') + labs(title="Fancy notch boxplot \n with 2 lines")
```
